pli-tv-kd11:6.1.3: “mayaṃ āvuso saṅghena tajjanīyakammakatā sammā vattāma, lomaṃ pātema, netthāraṃ vattāma, kathannukho amhehi paṭipajjitabbanti.
pli-tv-kd11:6.1.6: “tena hi bhikkhave saṅgho paṇḍukalohitakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetu.”

pli-tv-kd11:6.2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno tajjanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd11:6.2.10: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno tajjanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd11:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena assajipunabbasukā nāma kīṭāgirismiṃ āvāsikā honti alajjino pāpabhikkhū.
pli-tv-kd11:13.1.3: mālāvacchaṃ ropentipi ropāpentipi. siñcantipi, siñcāpentipi. ocinantipi, ocināpentipi. ganthentipi, ganthāpentipi. ekatovaṇṭikamālaṃ karontipi, kārāpentipi. ubhatovaṇṭikamālaṃ karontipi, kārāpentipi. mañjarikaṃ karontipi, kārāpentipi. vidhūtikaṃ karontipi, kārāpentipi. vaṭaṃsakaṃ karontipi, kārāpentipi. āceḷaṃ karontipi, kārāpentipi. uracchadaṃ karontipi, kārāpentipi.
pli-tv-kd11:13.1.4: te kulitthīnaṃ kuladhītānaṃ kulakumārīnaṃ kulasuṇhānaṃ kuladāsīnaṃ ekatovaṇṭikamālaṃ harantipi, harāpentipi. ubhatovaṇṭikamālaṃ harantipi, harāpentipi. mañjarikaṃ harantipi, harāpentipi. vidhūtikaṃ harantipi, harāpentipi. vaṭaṃsakaṃ harantipi, harāpentipi. āveḷaṃ harantipi, harāpentipi. uracchadaṃ harantipi, harāpentipi.
pli-tv-kd11:13.1.5: te kulitthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājanepi bhuñjanti. ekathālakepi pivanti. ekāsanepi nisīdanti. ekamañcepi tuvaṭṭenti. ekattharaṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti. ekapāpuraṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti. ekattharaṇa pāpuraṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti. vikālepi bhuñjanti. majjampi pivanti. mālāgandhavilepanampi dhārenti. naccantipi. gāyantipi. vādentipi. lāsentipi.
pli-tv-kd11:13.1.6: naccantiyāpi naccanti. naccantiyāpi gāyanti. naccantiyāpi vādenti. naccantiyāpi lāsenti.
pli-tv-kd11:13.1.7: gāyantiyāpi naccanti. gāyantiyāpi gāyanti. gāyantiyāpi vādenti. gāyantiyāpi lāsenti.
pli-tv-kd11:13.1.8: vādentiyāpi naccanti. vādentiyāpi gāyanti. vādentiyāpi vādenti. vādentiyāpi lāsenti.
pli-tv-kd11:13.1.9: lāsentiyāpi naccanti. lāsentiyāpi gāyanti lāsentiyāpi vādenti. lāsentiyāpi lāsenti.
pli-tv-kd11:13.2.1: aṭṭhapadepi kīḷanti. dasapadepi kīḷanti. ākāsepi kīḷanti. parihārapathepi kīḷanti. santikāyapi kīḷanti. khalikāyapi kīḷanti. ghaṭikāyapi kīḷanti. salākahatthenapi kīḷanti. akkhenapi kīḷanti. paṅgacīrenapi kīḷanti. vaṅkakenapi kīḷanti. mokkhacikāyapi kīḷanti. ciṅgulakenapi kīḷanti. pattāḷhakenapi kīḷanti. rathakenapi kīḷanti. dhanukenapi kīḷanti. akkharikāyapi kīḷanti. manesikāyapi kīḷanti. yathāvajjenapi kīḷanti.
pli-tv-kd11:13.2.2: hatthismimpi sikkhanti. assasmimpi sikkhanti. rathasmimpi sikkhanti. dhanusmimpi sikkhanti. tharusmimpi sikkhanti.
pli-tv-kd11:13.2.3: hatthissapi purato dhāvanti, assassapi purato dhāvanti, rathassapi purato dhāvanti. ādhāvantipi.
pli-tv-kd11:13.2.5: raṅgamajjhepi saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccantiṃ evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-kd11:13.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu kāsīsu vassaṃ vuttho sāvatthiṃ gacchanto bhagavantaṃ dassanāya yena kīṭāgiri tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd11:13.3.2: atha kho so bhikkhu pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kīṭāgiriṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi, pāsādikena abhikkantena paṭikkantena ālokitena vilokitena samiñjitena pasāritena okkhittacakkhū iriyāpathasampanno.
pli-tv-kd11:13.3.4: kvāyaṃ abalabalo viya, mandamando viya, bhākuṭikabhākuṭiko viya?
pli-tv-kd11:13.3.6: amhākaṃ pana ayyā assajipunabbasukā saṇhā sakhilā sukhasambhāsā mihitapubbaṅgamā ehisvāgatavādino abbhākuṭikā uttānamukhā pubbabhāsino.
pli-tv-kd11:13.3.8: addasā kho aññataro upāsako taṃ bhikkhuṃ kīṭāgirismiṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:13.3.9: disvāna yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā etadavoca:

pli-tv-kd11:13.4.3: “sāvatthiṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso gamissāmi bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd11:13.4.4: “tena hi bhante mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vanda. evaṃ ca vadehi:
pli-tv-kd11:13.4.6: assajipunabbasukā nāma kīṭāgirismiṃ āvāsikā alajjino pāpabhikkhū.

pli-tv-kd11:13.6.32: “kathaṃ mayaṃ bhante assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kīṭāgirismā pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoma, caṇḍā te bhikkhū pharusā”ti.
pli-tv-kd11:13.6.33: “tena hi tumhe sāriputtā bahukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ gacchathā”ti.

pli-tv-kd11:15.1.1: pabbājanīya kammakatena bhikkhave bhikkhunā sammā vattitabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd11:16.1.3: te saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakatā na sammā vattanti, na lomaṃ pātenti, na netthāraṃ vattanti, bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd11:16.1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd11:16.1.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakatā na sammā vattissanti, na lomaṃ pātessanti, na netthāraṃ vattissanti, bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd11:16.1.12: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:16.1.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi.
pli-tv-kd11:16.1.14: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakatā na sammā vattanti …pe…
pli-tv-kd11:16.1.28: tena hi bhikkhave saṅgho pabbājanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetu.

pli-tv-kd11:16.2.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pabbājanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd11:16.2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pabbājanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd11:17.1.2: tena bhikkhave pabbājanīyakammakatena bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā buḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:

pli-tv-kd11:18.1.2: yadā citto gahapati saṅghaṃ vā gaṇaṃ vā puggalaṃ vā nimantetukāmo hoti, tadā na āyasmantaṃ sudhammaṃ anapaloketvā saṅghaṃ vā gaṇaṃ vā puggalaṃ vā nimanteti.
pli-tv-kd11:18.1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā therā bhikkhū - āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca mahākaccāno āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito āyasmā ca mahākappino āyasmā ca mahācundo āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca revato āyasmā ca upāli āyasmā ca ānando āyasmā ca rāhulo kāsīsu cārikaṃ caramānā yena macchikāsaṇḍo tadavasariṃsu.
pli-tv-kd11:18.1.4: assosi kho citto gahapati ‘therā kira bhikkhū macchikāsaṇḍaṃ anuppattā’ti.
pli-tv-kd11:18.1.5: atha kho citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd11:18.1.6: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cittaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā sāriputto dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd11:18.1.7: atha kho citto gahapati āyasmatā sāriputtena dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito there bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd11:18.1.8: adhivāsentu me bhante therā svātanāya āgantukabhattanti.
pli-tv-kd11:18.2.1: atha kho citto gahapati therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yenāyasmā sudhammo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sudhammaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd11:18.2.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ sudhammaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd11:18.2.3: adhivāsetu me bhante ayyo sudhammo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ therehīti.

pli-tv-kd11:18.3.4: atha kho citto gahapati yenāyasmā sudhammo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sudhammaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.

pli-tv-kd11:22.1.1: napaṭippassambhetabba aṭṭhārasakaṃ atha kho saṅgho sudhammassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ akāsi,
pli-tv-kd11:22.1.3: so saṅghena paṭisāraṇīyakammakato macchikāsaṇḍaṃ gantvā maṅkubhūto nāsakkhi cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ. so
pli-tv-kd11:22.1.7: idāhaṃ āvuso macchikāsaṇḍaṃ gantvā maṅkubhūto nāsakkhiṃ cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetunti.
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.1: tena hi bhikkhave saṅgho sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūtaṃ detu
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.4: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhu yācitabbo. yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.6: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūtaṃ dadeyya cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.9: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūtaṃ deti cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.10: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūtassa dānaṃ cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.12: dinno saṅghena itthannāmo bhikkhu sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūto cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.13: khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.1: tena bhikkhave sudhammena bhikkhunā anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ macchikāsaṇḍaṃ gantvā citto gahapati khamāpetabbo
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.4: no ce khamati, anudūtena bhikkhunā vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.6: evaṃ ce vuccamāno khamati, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.7: no ce khamati anudūtena bhikkhunā vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.8: “khama gahapati imassa bhikkhuno. ahaṃ taṃ pasādemī”ti.
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.9: evaṃ ce vuccamāno khamati iccetaṃ kusalaṃ.

pli-tv-kd11:22.3.12: evaṃ ce vuccamāno khamati iccetaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.13: no ce khamati, anudūtena bhikkhunā sudhammaṃ bhikkhuṃ cittassa gahapatino dassanūpacāraṃ avijahāpetvā savaṇūpacāraṃ avijahāpetvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā sā āpattiṃ desāpetabbā’ti.
pli-tv-kd11:23.1.1: atha kho āyasmā sudhammo anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ macchikāsaṇḍaṃ gantvā cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpesi.
pli-tv-kd11:23.1.2: so sammā vattati, lomaṃ pāteti, netthāraṃ vattati. bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd11:23.1.3: ‘ahaṃ āvuso saṅghena paṭisāraṇīyakammakato sammā vattāmi, lomaṃ pātemi, netthāraṃ vattāmi.
pli-tv-kd11:23.1.6: tena hi bhikkhave saṅgho sudhammassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetu.
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.2: upasampādeti, nissayaṃ deti, sāmaṇeraṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, bhikkhunovādakasammutiṃ sādiyati, sammatopi bhikkhuniyo ovadati.
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.4: aparehipi bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.5: yāya āpattiyā saṅghena paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ kataṃ hoti taṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, aññaṃ vā tādisikaṃ, tato vā pāpiṭṭhataraṃ,
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.8: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.9: pakatattassa bhikkhuno uposathaṃ ṭhapeti, pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, savacanīyaṃ karoti, anuvādaṃ paṭṭhapeti, okāsaṃ kāreti, codeti, sāreti, bhikkhūhi sampayojeti.
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.10: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd11:25.1.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave channo bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ passitu”nti.

pli-tv-kd11:26.1.46: tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:26.1.47: eko bhaṇḍanakārako hoti kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako,
pli-tv-kd11:26.1.48: eko bālo hoti avyatto āpattibahulo anapadāno,

pli-tv-kd11:27.1.1: āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammakatena bhikkhave bhikkhunā sammā vattitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:27.1.8: yāya āpattiyā saṃghena āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kataṃ hoti sā āpatti na āpajjitabbā,
pli-tv-kd11:27.1.33: na pakatattena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekacchanne āvāse vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:27.1.35: na ekacchanne āvāse vā anāvāse vā vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:27.1.37: na pakatatto bhikkhu āsādetabbo anto vā bahi vā.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.1: [channassa bhikkhuno sammāvattanaṃ] atha kho saṅgho channassa bhikkhuno, āpattiyā adassane, ukkhepanīyakammaṃ akāsi –
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.3: so saṅghena, āpattiyā adassane, ukkhepanīyakammakato tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.4: tattha bhikkhū neva abhivādesuṃ, na paccuṭṭhesuṃ, na añjalikammaṃ na sāmīcikammaṃ akaṃsu, na sakkariṃsu, na garukariṃsu. na mānesuṃ. na pūjesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.5: so bhikkhūhi asakkariyamāno agarukariyamāno amāniyamāno apūjiyamāno asakkārapakato tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.6: tatthapi bhikkhū neva abhivādesuṃ. na paccuṭṭhesuṃ, na añjalikammaṃ na sāmīcikammaṃ akaṃsu. na sakkariṃsu. na garukariṃsu. na mānesuṃ. na pūjesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.7: so bhikkhūhi asakkariyamāno agarukariyamāno, amāniyamāno apūjiyamāno asakkārapakato tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.8: tatthapi bhikkhū neva abhivādesuṃ. na paccuṭṭhesuṃ. na añjalikammaṃ na sāmīcikammaṃ akaṃsu. na sakkariṃsu. na garukariṃsu. na mānesuṃ na pūjesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.9: so bhikkhūhi asakkariyamāno agarukariyamāno amāniyamāno apūjiyamāno asakkārapakato punadeva kosambiṃ paccāgañchi.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.10: so sammā vattati. lomaṃ pāteti, netthāraṃ vattati. bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.11: “ahaṃ āvuso saṅghena āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammakato sammā vattāmi. lomaṃ pātemi. netthāraṃ vattāmi.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.14: “tena hi bhikkhave saṅgho channassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetu”.

pli-tv-kd11:28.2.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd11:32.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.2: tena kho pana samayena ariṭṭhassa nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.3: ‘tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye’me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.4: assosuṃ kho sambahulā bhikkhū ariṭṭhassa nāma kira bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.5: ‘tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye’me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū yena ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo, tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.

pli-tv-kd11:32.1.9: ‘tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi: yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.10: “evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi: yathā ye me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti.

pli-tv-kd11:33.1.29: adesitāya āpattiyā kataṃ hoti, dhammena kataṃ hoti, samaggena kataṃ hoti …pe… aparehipi bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi …pe…
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.30: codetvā kataṃ hoti, dhammena kataṃ hoti, samaggena kataṃ hoti …pe… aparehipi bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi …pe…

pli-tv-kd11:33.1.33: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ dhammakammañca hoti, vinayakammañca, suvupasantañca:
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.35.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.36: bhaṇḍanakārako hoti kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako,
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.39: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.40: aparehipi bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.41: adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.42: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.43: aparehipi bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.44: buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati,
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.45: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.46: tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.47: eko bhaṇḍanakārako hoti kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako,
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.48: eko bālo hoti avyatto āpattibahulo anapadāno,
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.50: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.51: aparesampi bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya:

pli-tv-kd11:33.1.53: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya.

pli-tv-kd11:33.1.55: eko buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, eko dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, eko saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.56: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissage ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.57: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissage ukkhepanīyakamme ākaṅkhamānachakkaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.58.1: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammakatena bhikkhave bhikkhunā sammā vattitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.65: yāya āpattiyā saṅghena, pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kataṃ hoti sā āpatti na āpajjitabbā,
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.78: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakamme tecattāḷīsavattaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.1: atha kho saṅgho ariṭṭhassa bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ akāsi
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.3: so saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammakato vibbhami.
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammakato vibbhamissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.8: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammakato vibbhamī”ti
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma so bhikkhave moghapuriso saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammakato vibbhamissati.
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.16: “tena hi bhikkhave saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetu”.
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.2: upasampādeti, nissayaṃ deti, sāmaṇeraṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, bhikkhunovādakasammutiṃ sādiyati, sammato’pi bhikkhuniyo ovadati.
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissage ukkhepanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.4: aparehipi bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.5: yāya āpattiyā saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kataṃ hoti taṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, aññaṃ vā tādisikaṃ, tato vā pāpiṭṭhataraṃ,
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ na
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.9: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.10: pakatattassa bhikkhuno uposathaṃ ṭhapeti, pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, savacanīyaṃ karoti, anuvādaṃ paṭṭhapeti, okāsaṃ kāreti, codeti, sāreti, bhikkhūhi sampayojeti.
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.11: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.12: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakamme napaṭippassambhetabba aṭṭhārasakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.13.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.14: na upasampādeti, na nissayaṃ deti, na sāmaṇeraṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na bhikkhunovādakasammutiṃ sādiyati, sammatopi bhikkhuniyo na ovadati.

pli-tv-kd11:34.2.16: aparehipi bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.17: yāya āpattiyā saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ kataṃ hoti taṃ āpattiṃ na āpajjati, aññaṃ vā tādisikaṃ, tato vā pāpiṭṭhataraṃ,

pli-tv-kd11:34.2.21: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.22: na pakatattassa bhikkhuno uposathaṃ ṭhapeti, na pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, na savacanīyaṃ karoti, na anuvādaṃ paṭṭhapeti, na okāsaṃ kāreti, na codeti, na sāreti, na bhikkhūhi sampayojeti.
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.23: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahaṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:34.2.24: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā aṭippanissagge ukkhepanīyakamme paṭippassambhetabba aṭṭhārasakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.2: tena bhikkhave pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammakatena bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā buḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.3: “ahaṃ bhante saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammakato sammā vattāmi, lomaṃ pātemi, netthāraṃ vattāmi. pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge, ukkhepanīyassa kammassa paṭippassaddhiṃ yācāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.8: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammakato sammā vattati, lomaṃ pāteti, netthāraṃ vattati, pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge, ukkhepanīyassa kammassa paṭippassaddhiṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.9: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambheyya.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.12: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge, ukkhepanīyakammakato sammā vattati, lomaṃ pāteti, netthāraṃ vattati. pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyassa kammassa paṭippassaddhiṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.13: saṅgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambheti.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.14: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno, pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyassa kammassa paṭippassaddhi, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.19: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu saṅghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammakato sammā vattati, lomaṃ pāteti, netthāraṃ vattati, pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyassa kammassa paṭippassaddhiṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.20: saṅgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ paṭippassambheti.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.21: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyassa kammassa paṭippassaddhi, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.23: paṭippassaddhaṃ saṅghena itthannāmassa bhikkhuno pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.24: khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.25: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepanīyakammaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ sattamaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:35.1.26: kammakkhandhako niṭṭhito paṭhamo. imamhi khandhake vatthu satta.
